arguments.content: P1 review pattern: normalization adapters can bypass an established resilience boundary when they replace a policy-bearing repository method with a single-attempt primitive. A green test can conceal the regression by expecting immediate failure rather than the documented recovery. Review normalization and retry semantics independently through the public entry point: first-attempt success, recovery on attempts 2/3, exhausted transient failures, and immediate permanent failures, using both canonical and padded identifiers. Keep normalization outside the existing retry owner. Observed in preference-read staged review against HEAD 7c0410c18bac40c33f857000ac3cc59d38a02165; confirmed with actual HEAD and index snapshots.
